cards.claim: Sergio González Soriano represents RCD Espanyol de Barcelona.
cards.quote: Amidst this passionate landscape, a stalwart figure emerged, Sergio González Soriano, a Spanish association football player and manager, whose name became synonymous with RCD Espanyol de Barcelona, a sports club that has been the pride of Catalonia for over a century. As we delve into the narrative of Sergio's illustrious career, the evidence mounts, painting a vivid picture of his enduring connection with the Periquitos, Espanyol's affectionate nickname. Born on November 10, 1976, in Barcelona, Spain, Sergio's destiny was intertwined with the club from a young age. Growing up in the shadows of the iconic Estadi Cornellà-El Prat, he would often sneak into the stadium to watch his idols take the field, dreaming of the day he would don the blue and white jersey. Sergio's professional journey began in 1995, when he joined Espanyol's youth academy, La Masia. Under the guidance of seasoned coaches, he honed his skills, developing a unique understanding of the game that would serve him well in the years to come. The evidence of his early promise is evident in his rapid rise through the ranks, earning a promotion to the first team in 1998.

raw_card.claim: Sergio González Soriano was the captain of Espanyol from 2009 to 2011.
